string.text: The sit-down resolved without you. Quest items destroyed.
Auto-neutrality with bandits has ended.
A sealed package of operation papers. Bandits want it badly — mostly to dodge army routes. There are likely coordinates to a military field cache used to support such ops.
Classified package: countermeasures against criminal elements
Cannot buy neutrality
The informant refuses to sell neutrality after your actions at the meet.
Merc neutrality (1/2 price): %s
A flash drive from one of the bandit bosses. The military wants it — likely for the intel inside. A clever stalker might dig out something more valuable than talks or dirt.
Pakhan's flash drive
Stalker, you completely nuts? Burn the army and the brothers in one go? I respect the steel on you, but coming to me for neutrality anytime soon makes zero sense.
Looks like things cooled off. Should be able to deal with the brothers and the army again if you need.
You've got the flash. Take it to your shelter for the reward.
You've got the papers. Bring them to your shelter — reward waits there.
In the shelter crate:
Bring the item to your shelter to claim the reward.

Stalker! Since you joined the sweep — here's a job. One of the brothers should have a flash drive! They don't usually carry that junk; there should be only one. Bring it to your shelter; you'll pass it via Sakharov. We'll share supplies and intel. For God's sake, don't plug it into your PDA!

Damn, stalker, ballsy of you to hit the army. Respect! Listen — if you live, one of those goats should be packing a sealed stack of paper. No use to you, so haul it to the shelter; our courier will pick it up. We'll grease you proper. Just don't crack it open, got it?!
No free stashes — try later.
Could not create the field cache.
Military field cache
The package held field-cache coordinates. Stash on: %s (marked on map).
Could not create the Obshak stash.
Share of the obshak
On the flash you found coordinates to part of the brothers' current obshak. Stash on: %s (marked on map).

Stalker, thanks for the assist. A contact will leave you a gift — thanks to you we didn't have to spin a chopper for the brothers' souls, so you get fuel and a few extras. We also told the Informant that for the next couple of times his services can lean on our data when it concerns you. Mind you: in the Zone, stalkers get shot on sight. That's the job.

Oof, look at you, brother! Courier left you a little stash of goodies — but that's just flowers. The berries: for the next 4 days we're proper pals. Don't pay the informant where we work for real — walk easy, we'll cover you if needed. Can't stretch it longer — people will ask. And if you need a merc buyout once — I'll chip in half. Stay in touch.
Stalkers! A sweep of criminal elements is underway in the area! Anyone not sympathetic to the brothers — stay out of it. Those who try to help the bandits will be fired upon!
The hell you singing, sky in the clouds?! Stalkers — don't stick your noses in, or a stray bullet finds you. But shooting at us is a shit idea — you'll buy trouble up to your boots.

Meeting of Authorities

A bandit sit-down on a pinned smart and one army assault squad. You start neutral to both; your first hit picks a side. Commanders carry quest items (obshak flash / crime dossier). Turn them in to an ally or bring them home — or crack them open for a personal stash and open war. [Side choice, quest]
